learning_objective: 🎯 Dive into the magical games numbers play by discovering how they group together, multiply, and divide!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Factors are the exact numbers you can multiply together to build another number. For example, 2 and 3 are factors of 6 because 2 times 3 equals 6!
When you skip count by a number, like counting 5, 10, 15, 20, you are finding its multiples. It is like a frog jumping forward on a number line using the same step size every time.

fun_activity.title: 🍪 The Cookie Grouping Game
fun_activity.instructions: Grab 12 small items like beans, buttons, or cookies. Try to arrange them in equal rows. How many different rectangle shapes can you make? Each shape shows a pair of factors for 12!

quick_recap: ⭐ Factors divide evenly into a number without leaving any remainder.
⭐ Multiples go on forever as you keep skip counting higher and higher.
⭐ Every number has 1 and itself as a factor!
